link.hint: Recommended: link an account by logging in with your browser — no password needed
link.title: Browser Login Session
link.step1: 1. Open the DeepSeek login page and sign in (opens in a new tab)
link.step2: ② Drag the "Capture DS Session" button below to your bookmarks bar (**once only**); if dragging is not possible, click "Copy bookmark link", then right-click the bookmarks bar → add page → paste
link.dragHint: Drag this button onto your browser bookmarks bar (one time). Click it on the signed-in DeepSeek page to auto-capture.
link.step2Hint: The bookmarklet only needs to be added once. After that, clicking it on the signed-in DeepSeek page reads the session token / device fingerprint / browser UA and jumps back to this domain's capture page. While this panel is signed in, the capture page **authorizes automatically** — no further clicks, no F12 console.
link.step3: 3. (Fallback, usually unnecessary) If auto-authorization did not fire, click “Retry” on the capture page, or “Copy JSON” and paste it back here — both JSON and the capture-page URL (#d=...) are accepted
link.pastePlaceholder: Paste the capture page JSON here, or simply paste the capture page URL (#d=...)
link.emailPlaceholder: Email / mobile (fill manually if auto-detect fails)
link.submitOk: Authorized. The account is being verified (see the list below)
link.submitNotAdded: Link saved, but the account failed verification (state: {{state}}). The token may have expired — log in again in the browser and re-link.
link.parseFailed: Pasted content is not valid JSON
link.identityMissing: Could not detect account email/mobile — please fill it manually
link.dragGuide: Dragging is a one-time setup. The bookmark stays valid until you switch browser profiles.
link.step2Alt: After copying: right-click bookmarks bar → Add page → any name → paste the copied URL → Save. Then click it once.
link.qrHint: Click "Generate QR code" and scan it with WeChat — no bookmark dragging, no DevTools, nothing to install
link.qrScanHint: Scan the QR code below with WeChat, then tap "Confirm" on your phone
link.qrWaiting: Waiting for scan… (QR code expires in ~2 minutes)
link.qrSuccess: Authorized; account is being verified (see list below)
link.qrNotBound: Scan failed: this WeChat account is not linked to a DeepSeek account. Please link it on the DeepSeek website first, or use the bookmark method below.

settings.passwordMinLength: New password must be at least 6 characters.
settings.serverDescription: IP listen address, port binding, and Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) origins
settings.proxyDescription: Configure outbound proxy (HTTP/SOCKS5) if the server requires firewall or WAF bypass
settings.engineDescription: Official API endpoint, PoW WASM solver URL, and client headers
settings.responsesStoreDesc: In-process cache backing previous_response_id. Entries are evicted after the TTL or when capacity is exceeded.
settings.searchModeDesc: Whether web search is enabled when the request omits web_search_options. Disabling strictly follows the OpenAI semantics and avoids injecting DeepSeek search system prompts.
settings.quotaDesc: Upstream mutes accounts after a few hundred requests per hour, and muting is delayed. Accounts that exhaust this budget are skipped until the window rolls over (0 = unlimited). Add more accounts instead of raising this value.
settings.hifDesc: Upstream expects the x-hif-leim risk-control token on completion requests (real clients poll it from hif-leim.deepseek.com). When disabled the header is not sent — this is for A/B experiments only, keep it enabled in normal use.
